{{Otheruses}}
{{Quote|I'm ''so'' gratified to see you conscious and well.''"<br />"''That's a matter of opinion.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and Luke Skywalker, after Skywalker suffered a concussion|<ref name="Children of the Jedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
A '''concussion''' was a type of [[Brain/Legends|brain]] injury, commonly caused by a blow to the head, and treatable by [[antishock]]. [[Hohass Ekwesh]] received a concussion when he was hit in the back of the head with a [[Wine/Legends|wine]] bottle.<ref name="IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cilghal]] taught [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] about the physiological mechanism of a concussion, such that he knew where to apply [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to mend himself after he suffered one from a piece of debris.<ref name="Children of the Jedi" />
